setupLocal: mise trust --yes . && mise trust --yes apps/macos && mise trust --yes apps/web

if find node_modules/.bun -maxdepth 1 -type l | grep -q .; then echo 'node_modules/.bun links into the global Bun store, which Turbopack cannot follow. Keep install.globalStore = false in bunfig.toml.' >&2; exit 1; fi
